# Appendices

Three appendices that supply the background for the two main books: kinship terminology, document templates for wedding and funeral rites, and foundational concepts of the ritual order.

This book contains 3 sub-categories and 42 entries.

## Sub-categories

| Section | Entries | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [03-01 Traditional Kinship Terms](./03-01-kinship-terms/README.md) | 8 | The three systems of agnatic, maternal and afinal terms, together with their historical evolution and dialectal variation. |
| [03-02 Document Templates for Wedding and Funeral Rites](./03-02-document-templates/README.md) | 14 | The format and model texts of horoscope cards, marriage contracts, invitations, elegies, obituaries and grave inscriptions. |
| [03-03 Foundational Concepts of the Ritual Order](./03-03-ritual-concepts/README.md) | 20 | Concepts of the ritual order such as the five categories of rites, lineage law and the zhao-mu system, together with background on date selection, geomancy and the calendar. |
